Two texture losses: (a) Mark of Rot's boss-hit payload is un-tokened (name-only, unfetched); (b) Anomaly's time-replay/echo utility has no engine analog and maps only as a generic self_buff — a source player loses the 'replay your interactions' feel, but it is buff-utility, not damage identity.

mapping_json.fidelity_notes: Void -> shadow (§1). Resource is MANA (hot-fact: Void Well = Mana, no spirit/focus resource) — Void Essences are a proc-fuel counter for the regen passive, not a separate resource type. World Splitter (mandatory unique) DISSOLVES to the kit per §4 (its mechanic = enables the Mana-stack spam). RESOURCE_CONVERSION door: Mana-stacking-as-damage-enabler (huge-cost strike freely spammed via 30%/4s regen) is the build's engine. NO ailment token: 'obliterate'/'oblivion' are flavor; Mark of Rot NAMED but payload UNFETCHED (§0.4 name != payload) -> withheld (recorded as mark_identity annotation only). Anomaly's 'time copies replay interactions' is a novel time-echo utility with no clean engine lane — mapped as self_buff (Time Bubble), replay-flavor noted; NOT docket-worthy (it is a rider-utility, not the kit's identity loop; kit identity is the cleave, which maps cleanly).
mapping_json.motion_frame: Wind up and unleash one huge void cleave per cycle; Shattered Continuity removes its cooldown + Mana-stacking (Void Well regen) lets you spam it; Anomaly Time Bubble for buffs; Devouring Orb auto-casts for Void Essences; Healing Hands to move
